$comment: Dependency contract for this library. It is consumed as source (never installed),
so a consuming app must provide every package a tier imports. This file states
what each tier needs so that requirement is checkable instead of tribal knowledge.
deps     npm packages the tier imports directly.
requires other tiers it imports, resolved transitively by the checker.
shadcn   components the tier expects at <app>/src/components/ui/<name>.tsx.
Baseline assumed of every consumer and therefore not listed: react, react-dom,
typescript, and Node builtins. Apps opt into tiers, and exclude the rest from
their tsconfig; keep this file in step with the imports it describes.

core.description: Framework-free, dependency-free utilities. Safe in any app.

_classnames.description: Tailwind class merger. Split from core so that tier stays Tailwind-free, and kept out of tw so ui and slate can merge classes without inheriting Base UI.

next.description: Next.js helpers: imgix image loaders, href resolution, and the routing-only BlockLink.

tw.description: Tailwind/Base UI primitives, stylesheets, and the routed prose link.

ui.description: shadcn-based components. Renders against the app's own shadcn copies.

mui.description: MUI components. Mutually exclusive with tw/ui in practice.

mui-pages.description: Pages Router variants of the mui tier.

slate.description: Slate rich-text editor. Pulls MUI in via its toolbar.

types.description: Ambient declarations. Circular with slate by design.
